title: Algebraic Multigrid Acceleration for Efficient Label Spreading
abstract: arXiv:2608.26309v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern machine learning models rely on large amounts of labeled data. However, manual annotation of large-scale datasets is expensive and time-consuming. Label spreading is a semi-supervised learning technique that addresses this challenge by propagating information from a few labeled examples to a larger pool of unlabeled data. Despite its effectiveness, its application to large-scale, high-dimensional datasets is limited by computational costs and memory constraints. To address these limitations, we propose Algebraic Multigrid Acceleration for Efficient Label Spreading (AMELS), an efficient label spreading framework that improves scalability by fast construction of neighborhood graphs and the incorporation of algebraic multigrid solvers. The latter is an iterative solver that replaces the ordinary random walk iteration typically performed in label spreading. translated_title: 代数多重网格加速的高效标签传播
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26309v1 公告类型：新  摘要：现代机器学习模型依赖大量标注数据。然而，大规模数据集的人工标注既昂贵又耗时。标签传播是一种半监督学习技术，通过将信息从少量标注样本传播到更大的未标注数据池来解决这一挑战。尽管其有效，但应用于大规模、高维数据集时受限于计算成本和内存约束。为克服这些限制，我们提出了代数多重网格加速的高效标签传播（AMELS），这是一种高效的标签传播框架，通过快速构建邻域图并结合代数多重网格求解器来提升可扩展性。后者是一种迭代求解器，替代了标签传播中通常执行的普通随机游走迭代。由于代数多重网格求解器的多级特性，AMELS 能有效传播给定标签。
tldr: 本文提出AMELS框架，利用代数多重网格求解器替代随机游走迭代，加速标签传播并提升大规模数据集的可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AMELS, a framework that replaces random walk iteration with algebraic multigrid solvers to accelerate label spreading and improve scalability on large-scale datasets.
